183: Light years from Earth, 26 years after being abducted, Peter Quill finds himself the prime target of a manhunt after discovering an orb wanted by Ronan the Accuser.

To complicate matters, in order to get the assistance of the sole witness to a murder, they have to pretend to be each other.
695: A washed up golf pro working at a driving range tries to qualify for the US Open in order to win the heart of his succesful rival's girlfriend.

When the streets have gone to Hell, have faith in the devil.
1207: Held captive for 7 years in an enclosed space, a woman and her young son finally gain their freedom, allowing the boy to experience the outside world for the first time.
1463: A biologist signs up for a dangerous, secret expedition into a mysterious zone where the laws of nature don't apply.
1719: A murder victim is brought back to life by a mysterious crow. With the help of a beautiful woman, he exacts revenge on his killers – only to realize his enemy has discovered the one weakness that can destroy him forever.
Believe in the power of another.

Don't hunt what you can't kill.
2231: When a group of idealistic young men join the German Army during the Great War, they are assigned to the Western Front, where their patriotism is destroyed by the harsh realities of combat.
They left for war as boys never to return as men.
2487: Young lovers Sailor and Lula hit the road to start a new life together away from the wrath of Lula’s deranged, disapproving mother, who has hired a team of hitmen to cut the lovers’ surreal honeymoon short.
A wild and crazy love story.
2743: An international assassin known as ‘The Jackal’ is employed by disgruntled French generals to kill President Charles de Gaulle, with a dedicated gendarme on the assassin’s trail.
Nameless, faceless... relentlessly moving towards the date with death that would rock the world.
2999: When the old-old-old-fashioned vampire Vlad arrives at the hotel for an impromptu family get-together, Hotel Transylvania is in for a collision of supernatural old-school and modern day cool.
They're back to raise a little terror.

How one man betrayed the security of a nation.
3511: CW Briggs is a veteran insurance investigator, with many successes. Betty Ann Fitzgerald is a new employee in the company he works for, with the task of reorganizing the office. 3767: Santiago is an aging, down-on-his-luck, Cuban fisherman who, after catching nothing for nearly 3 months, hooks a huge Marlin and struggles to land it far out in the Gulf Stream.
SPENCER TRACY in his most suspenseful role...ERNEST HEMINGWAY'S story of Heroism...Defeat...Victory!
4023: Two college roommates venture out to identify a fellow student, who is most likely to commit suicide as it will help them pass the semester.
Roommate Wanted... For a Limited Time Only.
4279: After being thrown away from home, pregnant high school dropout Maria meets Matthew, a highly educated and extremely moody electronics repairman. The two begin an unusual romance built on their sense of mutual admiration and trust.
4535: Davey Stone, a 33-year old party animal, finds himself in trouble with the law after his wild ways go too far.
The ultimate battle between Naughty and Nice.

All is fair in love and Rome.

Born 2 the life. True 2 the code. Bad 2 the bone.
5303: Framed and on the run, a former FBI agent must save his family from a blazing fire in the world's tallest building.
5559: Michael Chapman, a former child TV star, runs a struggling talent agency specilizing in child acts. When a young girl off the street puts on a real performance after he catches her picking his pocket, he may have just found the next big thing.
He's a talent agent. She's a thief. Looks like they've already got something in common.
5815: A financially strapped mother joins a Mohawk woman to smuggle illegal immigrants into the United States.
6071: In 79 A.D., Milo, a slave turned gladiator, finds himself in a race against time to save his true love Cassia, the beautiful daughter of a wealthy merchant who has been unwillingly betrothed to a corrupt Roman Senator. As Mount Vesuvius erupts in a torrent of blazing lava, Milo must fight his way out of the arena in order to save his beloved as the once magnificent Pompeii crumbles around him.
6583: While driving through the New Mexico Desert during a rainy night, college students Jim Halsey and his girlfriend Grace Andrews give a ride to a hitchhiker. This sets off a chain of events that will change all of their lives forever.

The FIRST Certified Crazy Person's Comedy.
7095: Based on the autobiographical novel, the tempestuous 6-year relationship between Liberace and his (much younger) lover, Scott Thorson, is recounted.
Too much of a good thing is wonderful.

A Chicago cop from the hills of Kentucky. Hunting his brother's killer. Seeking justice country style.
7607: In Los Angeles, a colorful assortment of bohemians try to make sense of their intersecting lives. There's only one way these two are going to get along...
8119: Hugo Chavez was a colourful, unpredictable folk hero who was beloved by his nation’s working class. When he was forcibly removed from office on 11 April 2002, two independent filmmakers were inside the presidential palace.
8375: Martin is a neurotic web designer taking baby steps out of the isolation of his one-room apartment and his virtual reality. Mariana is an artist fresh out of a long relationship. How do you find love when you don’t know where it is?
8631: When a chance encounter brings together the cynical Dell and the quick-witted Kimberly, the stage is set for a tempestuous love affair that unfolds like a puzzle. As the film zigzags back and forth in time — from a meteor shower in LA, to an encounter in a Paris hotel room, to a fateful phone call — an unforgettable portrait of a relationship emerges.
8887: No beau? No problem! To earn money for college, a high schooler creates a dating app that lets him act as a stand-in boyfriend.
He's whoever you want him to be.

A master director shining his light on the best rock band on the planet.
Self - The Rolling Stones Vocals, Guitar, Harmonica
Self - The Rolling Stones Guitar, Vocals
Self - The Rolling Stones Saxophone, Keyboards
9399: The love story of young Countess Natasha Rostova and Count Pierre Bezukhov is interwoven with the Great Patriotic War of 1812 against Napoleon's invading army.
The greatest novel ever written ... Now magnificently alive on the screen!
9655: Against all the odds, a thirteen year old boy in Malawi invents an unconventional way to save his family and village from famine.
9911: A recent high school graduate is faced with two options, either go to a business school where his father wants him to go to, or get a full time job. He's got 24 hours to convince the one girl he really loves that he's honest, faithful, and fully committed. It's going to be a long night.
10423: A rebellious youth, sentenced to a boy’s reformatory for robbing a bakery, rises through the ranks of the institution by impressing its Governor through his prowess as a long distance runner. He is encouraged to compete in an upcoming race, but faces ridicule from his peers.
10935: A terminally ill teen upsets her parents when she falls in love with a small-time drug dealer.

What could be worse than having your best friend die?

11703: As a lone spaceship proceeds on its long voyage across space, the crew are surprised to encounter a strange pyramid form. ALIEN was the beginning… Hell Has Just Been Relocated!

He was a powerful warrior from the future, trapped in a prehistoric land, battling for the survival of his people.
12215: A hard-nosed Chicago cop is sent to London to bring back an American mobster being held for extradition. Brannigan in his Irish-American way brings American law to the people of Scotland Yard but has to contend with a stuffy old London first.
Big Jim Brannigan takes on London - Chicago Style !

All those individualists will learn to respect each other.
12727: The patriarch of a wealthy and powerful family suddenly passes away, leaving his wife and daughter with a shocking secret inheritance that threatens to unravel and destroy their lives.

They hoped to heal the scars of war away in a small English village. But the war within was just beginning…
13751: A young woman held in captivity discovers the realities of truth and lies in the outside world.
14007: Alice, a single mother who is more dedicated to her work as a genetic engineer than to her teenage son Joe, develops a new variety of flower that is supposed to have the ability to make its owner happy thanks to its special chemical properties.
14263: A jazz singer and a British jewel thief are brought together by their mutual desire to forget the past.
le pharmacien et le docteur Lamy

With the help of his assistants, the photographic creations gradually penetrate the peaceful households of two upper-class Russian families.

15799: Take a musical odyssey through five weird and wonderful decades with brothers Ron & Russell Mael, celebrating the inspiring legacy of Sparks: your favorite band’s favorite band.

Never underestimate the power of a woman.

A chase where only the strongest survive.

A one-eyed major and his oddball heroes fight a twentieth-century war in a tenth-century castle!

An out of the ordinary weekend in the life of an Argentine family
17847: While touring abroad in Europe, beautiful American skydiver Fathom Harvill gets wrapped up in international intrigue when Scottish spy Douglas Campbell recruits her to help him on a secret mission. Before long, Fathom realizes that no one around her, including the mysterious Peter Merriweather, can easily be trusted, leading to various adventures that involve bull fighting, beaches and, of course, romance.
The world's most uncovered undercover agent!
Col. Douglas Campbell, Chief of HADES
18359: A brilliant but clumsy high school senior vows to get into her late father's alma mater by transforming herself and a misfit squad into dance champions.
18871: The misadventures of Attila and his band of barbarians as they take up arms against the Roman Empire in their native Milano
19127: Two young horse traders guide a Mormon wagon train to the San Juan Valley and encounter rugged terrain, the cutthroat Clegg gang, hospitable Navajo, and moral challenges on the journey.
John Ford's lusty successor to "Fort Apache" and "She Wore a Yellow Ribbon"
19383: Handed over to foster care by his mother—who's unwilling to give up permanent custody—the now-adolescent François understands that nothing in life is permanent, and his increasingly erratic actions reflect this knowledge.

When destruction rises, can life prevail?
19895: Five Norwegians head for a cabin in the wilderness for a few days of teambuilding. But strange things start happening — especially down by the water where they find an abandoned tent. Is there someone else?
They should have stayed away from that water

Everyone has a breaking point. Tonight, she reaches hers.

20663: A multi-dimensional interface between a comic book artist, a novelist, and a film director. Each lives in a separate reality but authors a story about one of the others.
21431: Four former soldiers reunite 25 years after the war. Last time they saw each other on the Byelorussian railway station in the summer of 1945. Now they've come together to mourn the death of a friend.

A story based on true events.

23223: During the partition, Tara marries Sakina and they live a happy life. However their happiness is short-lived when Sakina's father forces her to stay in Pakistan and separates her from her family.

If you're searching for new adventure, "this is the way."

24247: An unexploded WWII bomb is discovered on a busy construction site in the centre of London. Chaos ensues as the military and police begin a mass evacuation against a ticking clock.

One survivor. One island. One warrior. Two men, against all odds.

Her romance is on pins and noodles.
25015: After a year of long-distance, Raquel and Ares reunite on a steamy beach trip. Faced with fresh flirtations and insecurities, will their love prevail?

Soon, Vishal is released from prison, and begins to work for Jindal. A quiet neighborhood. A deadly past.

Sometimes, letting go is the only way to hold on.
26039: An evil scientist implants the brain of a murdered high school student into an animatronic Tyrannosaurus, who later wreaks vengeance on the bullies who killed him, and is reunited with his sweetheart.
26295: A thief tries to go straight, but when predatory banks trap his father in debt, he returns to crime — with a determined cop closing in on his trail.
Sometimes, staying dangerous is the only way to stay alive.

Deeply buried secrets rise from the ashes and an unexpected familial bond begins to form as the mismatched duo tries to survive the merciless American Frontier.
26807: A thief's life changes after he discovers a little girl who claims he is her father, and what follows is violence after a gang hunting for his lookalike closes in on him.
Athili Sathi Babu / Vikram Singh Rathore
27063: Not satisfied with the result of a murder investigation in Warsaw's gay community, an officer in 1980s communist Poland resolves to uncover the truth.

27575: A woman who hails from a middle-class family background aims to excel in the competitive world of cricket with the help of her supportive father.
27831: An aimless adolescent joins several itinerant misfits who live on the fringe of society and welcome at-risk youths into their fold.
Close your eyes and picture the perfect world.

When an incident changes their lives drastically, bringing the two women under the same roof, they find themselves putting to test an unusual situation; can two mothers make a home?
A family... in an unusual situation.

28855: When a woman is found in a shipping container with no memory of who she is, two detectives race to figure out her identity — and who wants her dead.
29111: Sultana is a drama set in Istanbul's one and only strip club, telling a story of a women, power, rivalry and solidarity. A new Turkish story where women are not victims in a fairy tale, but warriors learning that the 'handsome prince' is often the real monster- and their only salvation is each other. Meral the long reigning queen of the one and only strip club of Istanbul which is Sultana, takes a talented new Belarusian dancer named Anna under her wing. But she soon realizes she has created a rival powerful enough to replace her, and a ruthless power struggle erupts between the two women.
29367: When a retired judge is found dead in his house, the cops find 4 suspects who visited him on the day of the murder. Soon, each confess to their reasons for hating the man. Who is the real killer?
29623: When the daughter of the town's new priest goes missing during the harvest festival, a desperate search begins, uncovering the town's dark history and resurfacing tales of a mysterious, malevolent spirit that demands sacrifice.

What ensues is a tense back-and-forth game of vengeance. By the end, William comes to find that the quest for revenge never has a winner.
30135: A documentary of the German national soccer team’s 2006 World Cup experience that changed the face of modern Germany.
30391: In the not-too-distant future, the last two men on earth must adapt and evolve to save humanity.
30647: A horrible accident takes place between two buses on the highway in Behrampore which includes students returning after winning their kabadi match, a newly-wed couple, a lover taking his love of life to meet his parents and a girl traveling for the very first time to the city of Kolkata - later it's revealed how lives of two couples among those passengers were connected and things take a tragic turn after the accident.
30903: Near the end of WWII, a young bootlegger and his nightclub-singing girlfriend assemble a ragtag team for an dangerous heist: to steal Mussolini's treasure right from his headquarters.
31159: Faking his death to escape the realities of his uneventful life worked out well for Brij Mohan -- until he was sentenced to death for his own murder.
31415: A lonely widow plans a trip around the world with her husband's ashes, to visit the places they loved in the movies. During her first stop in Scotland at the beautiful estate she stays in, she meets the innkeeper who changes her life forever.

Dive into the fantastical underwater world.

32183: A fight promoter deeply in debt to his crooked rival and desperate for a new fighter catches a break when a 450 pound church handyman who has spent his entire life in an orphanage agrees to wrestle on behalf of his fellow orphans.

32695: A married man who killed the wife of his best friend during a tryst feels compelled to turn himself in.
32951: The political party, which Mahsun, Şahin and Mehmet established as a front to secretly gamble, accidentally entered the parliament. 33207: When a woman tries to outwit her husband's sexy young mistress, the unexpected consequences include starring as King Lear in a very amateur production - with the mistress, an aspiring actress, playing The Fool.
33463: Grief-stricken after the loss of her child, Vanessa takes refuge at a lake house only to be met with an aberration of herself from a parallel universe and realizes the multiverse gates hold the key to releasing her grief or trapping her forever.
33719: Northern China, 2004. When miner Zhang Baomin returns to his home, a small and isolated mining village, his wife tells him that their son has mysteriously disappeared while shepherding his small flock.
33975: Stan gets a little annoyed when his Mum and Sister keep buying expensive items on hire purchase, but the money he earns for overtime working as a bus driver means that he can afford it... just! His job is secure, as bus drivers are hard to come by, and his overtime prospects are good, until the bus company decide to revoke a long standing rule and employ women bus drivers. Aghast at the thought of
From Telly Laughs To Belly Laughs!

When Hayat’s mother gives birth to her new-born brother, Hayat must accept the brutal custom by sacrificing herself to these creatures or find a way to escape.
Bound by tradition. Controlled by no one.
34487: In the gay '90s, cardsharps take over a Mississippi riverboat from a kindly captain. Their first act is to change the showboat into a floating gambling house. A ham actor and his bumbling sidekick try to devise a way to help the captain regain ownership of the vessel.
A Show Boat Load of Laughter!

After a defector is killed, things escalate into a full-fledged battle with serious geopolitical ramifications.
Two proud heroes with no one left to fight... But each other.
34999: The true life story of Wendell Scott, the first black stock car racing driver to win an upper-tier NASCAR race.
35255: Nikos is a master of funeral ceremonies (that's undertaker to you and me) who doesn't expect much from life. After drunkenly insulting a diplomat at a party, weird things begin to happen for Nikos. The news that a mysterious stranger offended the hated Deputy Prime Minister galvanizes the political elite assembled at the banquet, and a rumor that Nikos can take care of anything spreads like wildfire, making him an idol of the masses.
35511: Explores Leni Riefenstahl's artistic legacy and her complex ties to the Nazi regime, juxtaposing her self-portrayal with evidence suggesting awareness of the regime's atrocities.
35767: Written by comedian Peter Helliar, I LOVE YOU TOO stars Brendan Cowell as Jim, a 30-something emotionally stunted man whose inability to declare his love to his girlfriend, Alice, threatens to cost him the best thing he ever had but leads him to befriend a talented dwarf who helps him find the words to get her back.
36023: Mathimaran, a police constable, wants to do something worthy of his job and stumbles upon an organ trafficking ring run by Durai that is exploiting immigrant labourers. But, with Durai's connections inside the force and in politics going deep, can the cop succeed?
36279: A group of Korean tourists is taken hostage by an extremist Taliban group in Afghanistan. Only 24 hours left to accomplish the mission impossible.
36535: Bheeman realizes the inconvenience caused by an old pathway when he had to take his mother to the hospital. His life takes an interesting turn when he decides to broaden the pathway.
37303: A young woman, Chloe, living by her wits on the streets of New York City, has a chance meeting with a wise Inuit Eskimo, Theo, who was sent to New York by his elders to provide a message to the people of the world – We either change our destructive was or be destroyed by them. Together they will change the world.
37559: A minister dispenses justice on three convicts who take his family hostage.
There is no greater violence than a father's revenge for the rape of his daughter.
37815: In a remote part of rural, post-apocalyptic England, now occupied by unseen alien invaders, a feisty teenage girl sets out on a desperate attempt to fight back a group of bandits and defend her parents' farm, their remaining livestock, and the solar panels that keep them safe from extraterrestrials. If she doesn't succeed, she will lose her only source of food and shelter; if she resists, she and her helpless blind sibling will be killed.
38327: Family Struutz lives in Bitterfeld (GDR). After the fall of the wall, they take the opportunity to go on holiday with their car, an old Trabant. They simply want to visit Italy. But there are some incidents during their journey.

The Man-By-Man Story of a Lost Soul!
38839: A brash young lawyer takes a short-term, high-paying job as bodyguard for a slick business exec being threatened by a former partner, and quickly realizes he may be in over his head.
39095: A couple trapped in a cinema are manipulated into becoming unwilling actors in a film being captured by CCTV cameras.
He Gave His Life to the Movies. Tonight, He'll Take Theirs.

Our Father who art in trouble...
39607: A young family leaves their home on Kauai. It is time to return to the itinerant path from which all things in their uncommon lives come; beginning and ending on a remote dot in the Pacific. It is what they will learn, what they bring others, what they will pass on to their children in the hyper-expanded classroom, the lab of direct being; a legacy passed from a father to his family.
39863: A psychiatrist's adulterous past continues to haunt her and her husband after they move to India.

Be careful what you wish for.
40375: A group of young people sets sail for the Mediterranean to save the lives of refugees — a mission that puts their ideas of law and justice to the test.
40631: Lucky is a small time criminal and he's happy just getting by until he agrees to look after some counterfeit money for a friend who is in a bit of trouble with the law Two months go by without a word from him so Lucky burns the 'funny money' to avoid problems for himself.
40887: A socialite masquerades as a notorious femme fatale to win back her straying husband during a costume party aboard a doomed dirigible.
41143: The story of one night in the lives of a group of young Native American men and women who have left their reservations and are now living in the Bunker Hill district of Los Angeles.

They can shut the artist up, but never his poetry

41911: A jewel thief and a con artist are rivals in the theft of a valuable diamond and gem necklace in Bombay and as the Japanese Army invades China.
Stealing jewels for profit . . . and hearts for pleasure!
42167: Priya decides that she wants to be a nun, much to the horror of her father and Thomas, the boy who is in love with her. Thomas decides to enlist the help of Deva to change her mind.
42423: Kingdom of Joseon, ancient Korea. A usurper has conquered the throne. His ministers are being systematically eliminated by a mysterious assassin. An arrogant master swordsman is in charge of putting an end to the carnage.
42679: A tax collector is accused of taking bribes, and also has to deal with problems at home.
42935: Lady L is an elegant 80-year-old woman who recalls her amorous life story, including past loves and lusty, scandalous adventures she has lived through.
She's the only lady who ever got a boyfriend for a wedding present!

In a single night, their reckless game shatters the illusion of invulnerability in Budapest’s youth scene.
43447: Tells the story of a woman who gets involved in politics with no previous contact with world events.
The Young Woman in the Church

When they pick up a hitchhiker named Boris, the friendship of the two starts to fray. Maybe three’s a crowd after all? By the end of the summer, things between Jonas and Phillip won’t ever be the same again.

Bring on the thrills. Bring on the kills. Bring on the cheer.

Terror stalks the street of opium dreams!

Longing...Love...Lust...Life, Lorna . . . the embodiment of fulfillment and desire.

Things get so complicated that not even Lilly’s confession can solve the misunderstanding.

A Singer. A Fighter. A Symbol.

It's got some new ideas about multiple dwelling!

Being different is the main attraction.

Is there a reason for them to get involved with the goons?

47799: Two brothers are having a concert but one of them falls in love with a girl, now it's going to be hard for the two to work together.

Both these guys are out to win her heart... and it's gonna get ruff.

She intends to live in her father's house, which in the mean-time became a pub. From that moment her revenge begins, toying with to people, their passions and interests.
48567: When the circus leaves town, Zygmunt and Marysia unwittingly adopt a camel into their home. The couple quickly forms a close bond with the nameless camel, but as the bond grows stronger, their neighbors slowly begin to ostracize them.

I don't mind, how about you?

49079: Tom is seduced by Lilith, a succubus who's out to drain him and destroy his marriage.
She hunts to mate and mates to kill.

It took him forty bullets to get to Fort Dobbs... It took a thousand miracles to get him out!

Returned from the dead to stalk human prey!

A Journey Into Humanity And Faith.

The film stars Rii Sen who won the best actress award at Osian's Cinefan Festival of Asian and Arab Cinema for her bold act in the movie.[
51383: A young environmentalist wakes, trapped, kidnapped in the elevator of a super high rise building at the mercy of her tormentors.

Behind one door a desperate man. Behind the other a vulnerable, lonely woman. Between them a ruthless youth.
51895: Like a Candide dreaming of Eldorado, Jallel lands in France, hoping to try his luck.
